final: WITH account_shares AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) as share FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM account_shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) as total_orders_above_avg, AVG(share) as avg_share_above_avg, AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM overall_avg) as avg_distance_above_avg FROM account_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM overall_avg)
